name: Space weather
summary: Geomagnetic activity minor (G1) after a moderate G2 storm
state: NOAA's scales peaked at G1 (minor) geomagnetic storm level in the 24 hours to 23:40 UTC on 1 Nov, down from G2 earlier, with no solar radiation storm or radio blackout. Minor storms pose no significant risk to power grids or satellites.
for_you: No disruption expected; aurora may be visible further south during storms.
why: Severe solar storms can disrupt satellites, GPS, HF radio and power grids.
drivers: Solar flares and coronal mass ejections; solar cycle 25 is near its peak.
